verdict.rationale: The docs establish an official ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows, including a floating Pets control for typing or voice requests. Computer Use lets ChatGPT see and operate graphical interfaces, taking screenshots, so screen access is covered. But no OS-level keyboard shortcut or global hotkey is documented; missing for 10: documented OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, hands-on corroboration of screen-access behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Run projects in parallel, work with files, use your computer, and keep long-running work moving from one desktop workspace.
Type a request or start a voice conversation from the floating Pets controls in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows.
With Computer Use, ChatGPT can see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS or Windows.
Your ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use.
